verdicts.reason: A: the bottle-in-circle shrinks to a tiny icon jammed against the top edge and stacked on top of the Try It button, so the product is lost. NEW and Try It are small and crowded into the right corner. B: the bottle is a readable size, but it has lost its circle backdrop, is clipped at the bottom edge and sits tight against the headline. The NEW badge also overlaps the top of the Try It button and pushes against the top edge. B is marginally better because the product stays visible.
